Controlled sabotage and scheming studies, oversight limits, monitoring audits and conceptual control arguments expose failure modes. Prompted model organisms, historical audits and disputed causal explanations retain their stated limitations. These are tracked as background rather than equated with frontier catastrophic-risk evidence.
